scope: Focused read-only frozen-stage recheck of SQLIRT2-01, initializer all-fd cleanup and staged consumer status checks. No DB, HTTP, tests or universal runtime proof.

resolution.SQLIRT2-01: Transient close failure now marks cleanup incomplete and lifecycle failed, notifies waiters, and raises infrastructure ImageError. Identity-check error marks failed before attempting cleanup; failed cleanup stays sticky. Subsequent admissions fail and shutdown completion cannot be claimed.
resolution.initializer: Helper cleanup attempts both source and image closes even when one fails; transfer receiver similarly attempts all received descriptors. Parent closes owned channels and any received descriptor on unsuccessful initialization and does not publish the gate.
resolution.consumer_status: Staged bootstrap checks sealed-image policy, identity, ready lifecycle and loaded configuration hash; staged runtime verifier additionally checks the frozen image and snapshot fields. These checks do not establish live database behavior.

limitations: Author reports stage-v4 104 passing tests without skips; this reviewer did not rerun them. IM31 actual PostgreSQL and IM32 full CLI remain external pending evidence.
Approval is limited to the stated recheck and is not authorization to promote or proof of universal runtime behavior.
